_source: PKJI 2023 (Pedoman Kapasitas Jalan Indonesia, No. 09/P/BM/2023), Bab 5 Kapasitas Simpang APILL and Lampiran 12. Page numbers are the document's own 'x dari 326'.
_formula: J = J0 x FHS x FUK x FG x FP x FBKi x FBKa  (Persamaan 5-4, hal. 108)
approach_type_basis: Right turns share the lane and get green together with the opposing straight flow, so the approach is 'terlawan' (tipe O), Gambar 5-4 hal. 106.

J0_type_O.source: Gambar 12-2 hal. 257: J0 untuk pendekat tak terlindung (tipe O) tanpa lajur belok kanan terpisah, fungsi dari LE, qBKa, qBKa,O. Values read off the graph by eye (+-20 SMP/jam).
J0_type_O.interpolation: linear in qBKa, qBKa,O and LE, as the PKJI example on hal. 109 interpolates in LE

J0_type_P_formula: 600 x LE (Persamaan 5-6, hal. 108), kept for reference only

FHS_side_friction.basis: Tabel 12-3 hal. 270: akses terbatas (AT), terlawan, rasio kendaraan tak bermotor 0,00 -> 1,00

FP_parking.basis: Persamaan 5-5 / Gambar 12-11: no parking near the stop line

FBKa_right_turn.basis: Gambar 12-12 hal. 266 (FBKa = 1 + 0,26 x RBKa) applies to tipe P only; for tipe O the right-turn effect is already inside J0 (Gambar 12-2).

FBKi_left_turn.basis: Gambar 12-13 hal. 266 (FBKi = 1 - 0,16 x RBKi) applies to tipe P only.

signal_timing_checks.wK_yellow_s: 3,0 s, usual in Indonesian cities (hal. 112). Ours: 3 s. OK
signal_timing_checks.wAH_intergreen_s: Tabel 5-1 hal. 103: small intersection (average road width 6 to <10 m) -> 4 s per phase. Ours: road width 2 x 3,2 = 6,4 m; 3 s yellow + 1 s all-red = 4 s. OK
signal_timing_checks.wHH: Persamaan 5-10 hal. 112: sum of (wMS + wK) = 2 x 4 = 8 s. OK
signal_timing_checks.cycle_formula: Persamaan 5-11 hal. 112: s = (1,5 x wHH + 5) / (1 - sum Rq/J kritis), Webster (1966). OK
signal_timing_checks.green_formula: Persamaan 5-12 hal. 113: wHi = (s - wHH) x Rq/J kritis / sum Rq/J kritis. OK
signal_timing_checks.cycle_range: Tabel 12-2 hal. 269: two-phase 40-80 s; low values for approach width < 10 m (hal. 124). OK
